Faithful classic-script rewrite of vincentriemer/io-808
(https://github.com/vincentriemer/io-808), MIT, Vincent Riemer 2016.

Pinned to e744408089a4a75dfd1a336937ffb930ec9c5e7d (master at port time).
The original is React + Redux + StyleX + webpack; that stack is not shipped.
Drum-module graphs, envelopes, oscillator banks and the 808 step model
(16 patterns × 12 instruments × two parts × A/B) are copied from
src/synth/ and src/store-constants.js / src/initialState.js / src/helpers.js.

Audio is synthesised here, same as upstream — no samples, no CDN.
WAAClock is replaced by a small AudioContext lookahead timer (same
callbackAtTime / repeat / timeStretch job). Persistence is gifos.db,
not redux-persist / localStorage.
